sloka: भरतः च अपि वक्तव्यो यथा राजनि वर्तसे ।तथा मातृषु वर्तेथाः सर्वास्व् एव अविशेषतः ॥२-५२-३४॥
transliteration: bharataḥ ca api vaktavyo yathā rājani vartase ।tathā mātṛṣu vartethāḥ sarvāsv eva aviśeṣataḥ ॥2-52-34॥

translations.english: You should tell Bharata that just as he treats the king so should he treat all the mothers without differentiating betwen them.
